text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stoically pushing herself to the limit, 
Mejiro Ramonu continues to grow 
relentlessly even after entering the 
Senior Class—perhaps as a gift of the 
power of love.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those around her were filled with awe... 
Even the Umamusume who had viewed Mejiro 
Ramonu as a rival since the Oka Sho and 
chased after her felt how distant she 
truly was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the day of the Victoria Mile arrived. 
Umamusume who had made their mark along 
the Tiara route throughout each 
generation. Aiming to stand at the 
pinnacle, they take to the track now—!
